gamefaqs.section: GameBoy Advance GameShark SP Save File (North America)

format: gzip-compressed VisualBoyAdvance save state (.sgm), state version 6, ROM header "POKEMON SAPP" / 'AXPE', 739786 bytes inflated; not a battery save

mgba.detail: not a battery save: a VisualBoyAdvance save state, which no core here loads

note: A VisualBoyAdvance desktop save state, not a save: VBA keeps the battery memory inside it, but getting it out means following VBA-M's whole state reader (CPUReadState), which was not done here. No libretro core loads VBA's desktop states.
